sharedPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve game character animation frame. Edit the supplied isolated avatar reference. Exactly ONE full-body cute crisp pixel-art chibi character on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Preserve face identity, eye color, hairstyle, hair color, and the exact distinctive hair accessory. Keep the same pixel-art style, head/body proportions, camera, centered framing and foot baseline as the reference. Only the situation-appropriate outfit and the requested pose may change. Entire hair, arms and shoes visible with generous empty transparent margins. No background, floor, scenery, shadows, other person, duplicate body, ghost trails, lettering, logo, watermark, border, sprite sheet or collage. Native clean pixel clusters, no blur.

avatars.0: black bob, purple flower hairclip, lilac accent
avatars.1: brown bob, green music-note hairclip, mint accent
avatars.2: long brown hair, pink flower hairclip, peach-pink accent
avatars.3: black parted hair, blue star hairclip, blue accent
avatars.4: blond hair, gold star hairclip, warm yellow accent
avatars.5: silver hair, teal music-note hairclip, teal accent
